model_proposal.rationale: Four internal nodes (7,11,10,9) are moved toward their neighbor-anchor medians to compress the vertical fanout stack feeding output 3. Node 7 shifts from y=26→25 (median of 5,9,3), node 11 from y=26→25 (median of 10,3), node 10 from y=25→24 (median of 6,11), and node 9 from y=23→22 (median of 8,7). This eliminates the long edge [9,7] (Manhattan 5→3), reduces max y from 31 to 30 (height 11), and tightens the right-side column (x=24→23 for node 11), shrinking bounding box to width 5, height 11 (area 55). All moves preserve adjacency and avoid collisions; ports remain fixed but internal contraction enables area reduction without relying on port motion.
